fields.label: Listing URLs (Deep)
fields.description: Optional, one per line. Used by the Deep method instead of Site URL when Site URL is a bare homepage rather than a product listing (e.g. anthropologie.com). Falls back to Site URL if left blank.

fields.label: Categories
fields.description: Comma-separated list of categories (e.g. Earrings, Necklaces)

fields.label: Scrape Method
fields.description: Auto = try Shopify JSON first, fall back to Firecrawl. Deep = generic Playwright-based scraper (pagination discovery, JS rendering) — opt-in only for now, not part of Auto.

fields.label: Deep: Max Products
fields.description: 0 = unlimited (bounded only by the time budget). Used by the Deep method as a hard cap per run.

fields.label: Deep: Filter To Jewelry Only
fields.description: If the match rate across a run is very low, Deep keeps everything and logs the fact rather than silently discarding most rows — this only forces the filter on when it's actually working.

fields.label: Deep State (internal)
fields.description: JSON resume cursor + discovered pagination scheme. Managed by the Deep scraper — do not edit by hand.
